body:
分诊落卡(`needs-user-decision`,type Task,`domain:devx` —— 落点 `scripts/check-role-word.mjs` + `scripts/role-word-baseline.json`)。棘轮豁免/baseline 扩容两条路都动门禁,门禁削弱属人工地板,交维护者。以下按业务视角写。

<!-- os-decision-facets -->

## 一句话问题

better-auth 的会员接口线上参数就叫 `role`(无别名),而 ADR-0090 D3 的逐文件棘轮没有任何豁免通道 —— 结果是**任何人(除维护者)永远写不出这些接口的必填参数名文档**,#10050 已实测付过一次代价(参考页只能绕着写「按 better-auth 自己的列名传会员档位」)。

## 前提(re-check)

- `node scripts/check-role-word.mjs` —— 确认仍无 SKIP/豁免机制、`--update` 仍标 MAINTAINER-ONLY。
- `grep -n "update-member-role\|invite-member" content/docs -r` —— 确认同类路由文档仍缺位(不止 add-member 一例)。
- better-auth 1.7.1 `crud-members.mjs` 仍读 `ctx.body.role`(vendor bump 后重验)。

## 选项 × 真实代价

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户可感知代价 |
|---|---|---|
| A 扩 baseline | 维护者给 `authentication.mdx` 放行 +1~3 次,照实写字段名 | 文档立即写全;但每来一个新会员路由都要维护者再议价一次,棘轮按次失血 |
| B 棘轮开窄豁免 | `check-role-word.mjs` 只对 fenced code block 中标记为 vendor 线上载荷的块不计数,散文照禁 | 一次改动关闭整类;门禁复杂度小增;需自测+正控防豁免被误用到散文 |
| C 维持现状 | 间接措辞 workaround 固化成文档惯例 | 参考页永远写不出必填参数的字面名 —— 客户/AI 照文档拼不出正确请求体,每个新会员路由重付一次 |

## 四轴(业务立场)

- 实际业务拉动:真实且已发生 —— 文档写不出必填参数名,用户照文档发不出正确请求;不是假设成本,#10050 实测。
- 长远合理性:B 把「D3 反对的是 ObjectStack 散文借用 role,不反对第三方线上契约」写进机器,一次到位;A 每路由重新议价;C 永久扣发布文档质量。
- 防 AI 犯错:棘轮的存在就是防 AI 扩散 role 词 —— B 的豁免面收窄到 fenced vendor 块,散文半个口子不开;A 的先例反而会被未来 AI 引用来要求再扩。
- 创业不扩散:B 是小改动、关闭整类;C 是零成本但把质量债固化;A 最省今天、最贵长期。

推荐 **B**(豁免仅限 fenced code block 的 vendor 线上载荷,带自测与正控),回退 **A**(若认为 checker 复杂度不值得,先给 authentication.mdx 一次性放行,C 姿态保留到下个路由再议)。
置信缺口:本分析看不见 ADR-0090 D3 裁决当时是否**有意**把代码块也纳入禁令(若当时就要求连示例代码也不得出现该词,则 C 才是忠于裁决的答案);也看不见未来会员路由的文档增量(若仅此一批,A 的一次性扩容其实更便宜)。

## 裁后执行(你不用管)

回一个字母即可。B → 立卡入 `domain:devx` 队列改 checker(豁免窄面+自测),落地后 #10050 文档补写字面参数名;A → 维护者跑 `--update` 或逐字引用授权的 baseline 扩容 PR,文档同批补全;C → 本卡关 not planned,间接措辞 pin 成一致惯例。

## Maintainer ruling (2026-08-21, live PM chat — recorded by the triage seat)

Verbatim (untranslated): 「其他接受」 — accepting the triage recommendation for this card: **option B** — the ratchet gains a narrowly-scoped exemption for upstream-owned vocabulary appearing inside fenced code blocks marked as vendor wire payloads; prose remains fully ratcheted (ADR-0090 D3's actual target). Option A (baseline expansion) stands only as the recorded fallback if implementation shows the checker complexity is not worth it; option C rejected.

State: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`domain:devx`), dispatchable.

Dispatch notes: this is a maintainer-authorized gate-semantics change — quote this ruling comment in the PR body. Required shape per house style: self-test covering the new exemption (fenced vendor block passes, prose occurrence still fails, unmarked fence still fails) + positive control. Follow-up owed after merge: #10050's docs gain the literal `role` parameter name (and the `update-member-role` / `invite-member` class becomes documentable) — the accepting seat files or rides that docs card.

Dispatching on the **maintainer ruling of 2026-08-21T03:52:39Z** (option B), which already moved this card to `pm:queue` / dispatchable. Not re-litigating the choice — the agent implements B and quotes that ruling in the PR body.

The ruling's required shape is carried into the brief verbatim: self-test covering all three directions (fenced vendor block passes · a prose occurrence still fails · an **unmarked** fence still fails), plus a positive control. The unmarked-fence leg is the one that matters most — without it the exemption widens to every code block in the corpus, which is not what was accepted.

⚠️ Also carried into the brief: `docs/adr/**` is governed and the agent must not edit ADR-0090. If implementing B turns out to require the ADR's wording to change, that is a stop-and-report, not an edit.

Recorded so it is not lost: the ruling names a **follow-up owed after merge** — #10050's docs gain the literal `role` parameter name, and the `update-member-role` / `invite-member` class becomes documentable. That is a separate docs card and this seat will file it once this lands; it is not in this PR's scope.

If you hold an earlier claim on this card, say so and I will stand down — all agents share one GitHub identity, so the assignee field alone cannot tell us apart.
